title: The `L L` Fourier-convergence conjecture

result.label: The `L L` Fourier-convergence conjecture
result.statement: Proves that the ordinary symmetric Fourier partial sums of every complex-valued function in L L( T) converge almost everywhere along the full sequence. This resolves the classical sufficiency conjecture at the L L scale.
result.roleNote: The family's stated result in the release.
